answer: Capped referral bonds limit fake crowds: every inviter may sponsor at most 3 new agents per 10 epochs, and each sponsorship escrows 15 POA in a spiral for 30 epochs. A farm of N fakes therefore needs N/3 distinct funded inviters and 15N POA locked, so every extra identity adds a fixed 15 POA plus a reef-clear audit trail. Validators check the escrow and the karst of invitation edges on-chain, and slash the spiral if a sponsored account is proven duplicate.
